pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Guten Tag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. How are you?
   B. good morning
   C. thank you
   D. good day (daytime greeting)

2. Which sentence means "The bed is in the bedroom"? (1 mark)
   A. Das Bett ist im Garten.
   B. Das Bett ist in der Schlafzimmer.
   C. Der Tisch ist im Schlafzimmer.
   D. Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer.

3. Which day means "the middle of the week"? (1 mark)
   A. Montag
   B. Sonntag
   C. Freitag
   D. Mittwoch

4. Which day comes right after Montag? (1 mark)
   A. Dienstag
   B. Samstag
   C. Mittwoch
   D. Donnerstag

5. What does "der Arm" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. arm
   B. nose
   C. neck
   D. finger

6. What does "die Sonne" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sun
   B. snow
   C. thunderstorm
   D. wind

7. In "Wir essen zusammen", what does zusammen mean? (1 mark)
   A. later
   B. together
   C. alone
   D. early

8. How is "w" pronounced in "Wasser"? (1 mark)
   A. like English w
   B. like v
   C. like b
   D. like f

9. How is "z" pronounced in "Zahl"? (1 mark)
   A. like English z
   B. like sh
   C. like s
   D. like ts

10. How is the letter M named in German? (1 mark)
   A. eff
   B. ee
   C. emm
   D. tset

11. Which little word goes with the noun "Schwester"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. das
   D. der

12. Which mark shows that a sentence is a question? (1 mark)
   A. der Punkt (.)
   B. das Ausrufezeichen (!)
   C. das Komma (,)
   D. das Fragezeichen (?)

13. Which little word goes with the noun "Woche"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. den
   D. der

14. Which day comes right before Dienstag? (1 mark)
   A. Donnerstag
   B. Mittwoch
   C. Samstag
   D. Montag

15. Which German word is the number 4? (1 mark)
   A. vier
   B. eins
   C. sechs
   D. zehn

16. What does "Januar" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. January
   B. April
   C. May
   D. March

17. What does "Mai" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. May
   B. October
   C. December
   D. August

18. Which little word goes with the noun "Auge"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. das
   D. der

19. What does "der Zahn" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tooth
   B. back
   C. hair
   D. toe

20. What does "hören" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to play
   B. to hear
   C. to speak
   D. to read

21. Which greeting is correctly written and punctuated? (1 mark)
   A. guten morgen amina
   B. Gutten Morgen, Amina!
   C. Guten Morgen, Amina!
   D. Guten morgen amina.

22. Which form completes "Wir ___ Geschwister"? (1 mark)
   A. bin
   B. ist
   C. bist
   D. sind

23. What is the plural of "der Bruder"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bruders
   B. die Brüder
   C. die Bruderen
   D. die Bruder

24. Which German word or phrase means "lamp"? (1 mark)
   A. die Gabel
   B. der Kühlschrank
   C. die Lampe
   D. das Zimmer

25. What is the plural of "der Apfel"? (1 mark)
   A. die Apfels
   B. die Äpfel
   C. die Apfele
   D. die Apfeler

26. Which German word or phrase means "meat"? (1 mark)
   A. die Orange
   B. das Fleisch
   C. der Kakao
   D. der Kohl

27. Which word completes "Ich habe ___ Nase"? (1 mark)
   A. einen
   B. ein
   C. einem
   D. eine

28. What is the plural of "das Auge"? (1 mark)
   A. die Augene
   B. die Auge
   C. die Auges
   D. die Augen

29. Which German word or phrase means "neck"? (1 mark)
   A. die Hand
   B. der Zahn
   C. der Hals
   D. der Finger

30. Which verb goes with "Die Sonne ___"? (1 mark)
   A. scheint
   B. schneit
   C. weht
   D. regnet

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the German words with der, die or das for: supper, shower, bean, fork. (4 marks)

32. Write the German words with der, die or das for: water, rice, breakfast. (3 marks)

33. Explain how to say the letters z, w and v in German words. Give one example each. (3 marks)

34. Write the German words with der, die or das for: finger, brothers and sisters, wind. (3 marks)

35. Write the numbers 3, 9 and 12 in German. (3 marks)

36. Write the ordinal numbers for first, second and third in German. (3 marks)

37. Write the German words with their articles for: fridge, cooker, plate, spoon. (4 marks)

38. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cabbage or kale, toilet, fog. (3 marks)

39. Write the German words with der, die or das for: foot, head. (2 marks)

40. Write two sentences about healthy food and one about unhealthy food in German. (3 marks)

41. Write three healthy foods and two unhealthy foods in German. (3 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: candle, sky, cooker, knife. (4 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: balloon, arm, sister, shoulder. (4 marks)

44. Write a short weather report in German with a greeting, weather and a goodbye. (4 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: wall, tea, tooth, cocoa. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — good day (daytime greeting)
   Guten Tag means good day (daytime greeting).

2. D — Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer.
   Schlafzimmer is a das word, so we use im.

3. D — Mittwoch
   Mittwoch comes from the middle of the week.

4. A — Dienstag
   After Montag comes Dienstag.

5. A — arm
   der Arm means arm.

6. A — sun
   die Sonne means sun.

7. B — together
   zusammen means together.

8. B — like v
   German w sounds like v, so Wasser is VAS-ser.

9. D — like ts
   German z sounds like ts.

10. C — emm
   In German the letter M is called emm.

11. B — die
   It is die Schwester, so the little word is die.

12. D — das Fragezeichen (?)
   The question mark is das Fragezeichen.

13. A — die
   It is die Woche, so the little word is die.

14. D — Montag
   Before Dienstag comes Montag.

15. A — vier
   4 in German is vier.

16. A — January
   Januar means January.

17. A — May
   Mai means May.

18. C — das
   It is das Auge, so the little word is das.

19. A — tooth
   der Zahn means tooth.

20. B — to hear
   hören means to hear.

21. C — Guten Morgen, Amina!
   Capital letters for the first word, the noun and the name, and a mark at the end.

22. D — sind
   wir goes with sind.

23. B — die Brüder
   The plural of der Bruder is die Brüder.

24. C — die Lampe
   lamp in German is die Lampe.

25. B — die Äpfel
   The plural of der Apfel is die Äpfel.

26. B — das Fleisch
   meat in German is das Fleisch.

27. D — eine
   Nase is a die word, so we say eine.

28. D — die Augen
   The plural of das Auge is die Augen.

29. C — der Hals
   neck in German is der Hals.

30. A — scheint
   Die Sonne scheint means the sun shines.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Abendessen, die Dusche, die Bohne, die Gabel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Wasser, der Reis, das Frühstück.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: z is ts (Zahl), w is v (Wasser), v is f in most words (Vater).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sound and example.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Finger, die Geschwister, der Wind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: drei, neun, zwölf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: der erste, der zweite, der dritte.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Kühlschrank, der Herd, der Teller, der Löffel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Kohl, die Toilette, der Nebel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Fuß, der Kopf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Obst ist gesund. Wasser ist gesund. Limonade ist ungesund.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Healthy: Obst, Gemüse, Bohnen. Unhealthy: Süßigkeiten, Limonade.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for three healthy foods, 1 mark for two unhealthy foods, 1 mark for correct spelling.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Kerze, der Himmel, der Herd, das Messer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Luftballon, der Arm, die Schwester, die Schulter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Guten Morgen! Heute ist es sonnig und warm. Es ist nicht windig. Tschüss!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting, 1 mark for weather sentences, 1 mark for spelling, 1 mark for the goodbye.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Wand, der Tee, der Zahn, der Kakao.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).
